name: preview-pane-two-questions
for: The FIRST question of a two-question dialog whose options carry a preview: the option list and a box drawn side by side, the box's top border on option 1's row. Captured live with three options. Before #204 every option read as label + padding + the box's row (73 characters), the question read as the tail of the agent's own prose + the tab bar + the question, and the nonce changed whenever the highlight moved because the box shows the highlighted option's preview. Pins: options are the list column alone, the question is the question alone, the pane is recognised, and the current tab is 1 of 2 (read from the highlight, which survives redaction as reverse video).
redactedFrom: real capture, redacted by corpus-redact (one runtime build, 2026-09-25); the labels and preview text were synthetic to begin with
